# clHCA subset dependency

`src/coding/libs/clhca.c`, `clhca.h`, `clhca_data.h` from vgmstream commit `7c520e8f9b078dfde2f84f1b5bcbad0c6c415806`, under the included ISC-style COPYING notice. Original/decompilation authors and source references remain in the source header. No keys, key guessing, vgmstream application, container parser or additional codec is included. File hashes are checked at CMake configure. Compiled as C99 with strict aliasing disabled because the upstream float tables alias bit patterns.

Engine owns admission, original-root input leases, exact Source coordinates, duration/loop/trim validation, error latching, finite PCM and transactional replay Seek. Only bounded plaintext HCA v2 comp headers are initially admitted; the decoder's wider capabilities are not product coverage. Header/frame CRC, exact lengths and bit-consumption bounds are checked by Engine. This library never owns Transport/Mixer/output. App license notice is under assets/licenses/vgmstream-clhca.txt.

Initial independent FFmpeg 7.1.5 comparison showed opposite global polarity on the original nonzero vectors (retained evaluation); no FFmpeg PCM parity is claimed. Direct double-precision DCT-IV/overlap-add using independently published VGAudio tables agrees with unmodified clHCA within 1.5e-8 for those vectors. No output sign compensation is applied. Real-file/CRI reference corpus remains pending.

Local patch `patches/0001-bound-bitreader.patch` fixes a reproduced UBSan invalid shift on CRC-valid tiny frames. Peek checks avoid addition overflow; word selection uses bytes available from the aligned byte start, and a bounded fallback handles non-byte-aligned 32-bit requests. Normal valid reads/output are preserved and retested against the same mathematical PCM goldens. Upstream original clhca.c SHA-256: `4ef480d075acd8da35271aba34a048fc7012fa7a0ca1f014a025080be70043f1`; patched file is pinned separately in CMake. Header/data tables remain unchanged. The initial failing sanitizer log is retained; no sanitizer pass is inferred from the pre-patch strict run.
